text:
```yaml
name: UpdateNugetPackageLockJson

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prNumber:
        description: 'PR Number'
        required: true
        type: number
  pull_request_target:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - labeled

jobs:
  update-nuget-package-lock-json:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Cancel previous runs of this workflow
        uses: rokroskar/workflow-run-cleanup-action@master

      - name: Setup .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '7.0'

      - name: Restore solution with force evaluate
        run: dotnet restore SonarScanner.MSBuild.sln --force-evaluate

      - name: Run Renovate bot
        uses: renovatebot/github-action@v46.1.5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          renovate-version: latest
          renovate-image: renovate/renovate:latest
          mount-docker-socket: false
          docker-socket-host-path: /var/run/docker.sock
          docker-cmd-file: null
          docker-network: bridge
          docker-user: root
          docker-volumes: []

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update NuGet package lock files"
          git push origin HEAD:$GITHUB_REF
```
